evidence.text: A widely shared article cites 'Northgate Research (2026), Review of Empirical Studies' reporting that a new alloy keeps its strength at 900C.
The article reproduces a figure in the journal's house style with a methods caption.
A search of the journal's archive for the cited volume and pages returns nothing at all.
Northgate Research's own 2026 publication list contains no study on this topic.
Two independent librarians confirm the citation does not resolve.
A widely shared article cites 'Northgate Research (2026), Annals of Measurement Science' reporting that a nasal spray reverses early memory loss.
The article reproduces a figure in the journal's house style with a methods caption.
The paper cites a preprint, and the preprint's only source for the claim is the article itself.
Northgate Research's own 2026 publication list contains no study on this topic.
Two independent librarians confirm the citation does not resolve.
A widely shared article cites 'Cedarfield Institute (2026), Quarterly of Field Research' reporting that a soil additive doubles wheat yield.
The article reproduces a figure in the journal's house style with a methods caption.
The figure is real but is lifted from a different study on an unrelated topic.
Cedarfield Institute's own 2026 publication list contains no study on this topic.
Two independent librarians confirm the citation does not resolve.
